Tool: mcp--playwright--browser_click target="ref-guilds-link" element="Guilds nav link" Tool: mcp--playwright--browser_wait_for time=1 Tool: mcp--playwright--browser_take_screenshot filename="03-guilds.png" fullPage=true
Tool: mcp--playwright--browser_navigate url="https://hellodj.celestium.life" Tool: mcp--playwright--browser_evaluate function="() => { /* contrast extraction JS */ }" → Result: [{text:"Active Guilds", fg:"rgb(108,117,125)", bg:"rgb(33,37,41)", ratio:"1.36", pass:false}]
